app.title: Light curve inspector and labeler
app.summary: A person enters a username, and any labels they saved before are loaded. They page through the collection nine plots at a time. Each plot is one time series folded at its known period and at twice that period. The current item has a highlighted outline. The person gives it a class from a fixed set of buttons, and the highlight moves on to the next item. They can step back one item to fix a label or jump to the first item still unlabelled. When a page is fully labelled, the labels are saved to a per-user backup file.

task.text: Assign each periodic time series in a collection to one of a fixed set of classes by looking at its period-folded shape.

data.text: A folder of time series files, each holding measurement times, values and errors, plus a list of file names with a known period for each. Each series gets one class label from a fixed list.
data.item: one periodic time series (a star's light curve) with its known period

stage.text: labelling periodic light curves after periods have been found, to build a labelled set

mechanism.text: A sidebar of buttons drives a 3×3 grid of phase-folded scatter plots. Page buttons change which nine series are drawn. A highlighted outline marks the current plot, and the class buttons label it and move the highlight forward, turning the page when the grid is done. Each plot's title shows its index, file, period and assigned class.

field.text: phase-folded light curve classification of periodic variable stars in astronomy

workflow.name: label every item in a collection with one class from a fixed set

steps.here: The server loads a folder of series files and a pickle of file names and periods, optionally cut to a subset. The person types a username and presses Ready, and any labels they saved before are loaded from that user's backup.

steps.step: look over every item at a glance
steps.here: Nine series per page in a 3×3 grid, each folded at its period and at twice its period, with error bars. Previous page and Next page buttons move through the collection, and a 'Page n out of m' readout shows where you are.

steps.step: step through items one at a time
steps.here: A red outline marks the current plot. After each label it moves to the next plot and turns the page at the end of the grid.

steps.step: apply a label from a fixed set to each item
steps.here: The buttons RR Lyrae, Eclipsing Binary, Cepheid and Other set the current series' class and write it into the plot title.

steps.step: go back and correct a decision
steps.here: 'Go back one' moves the highlight to the previous plot, across a page boundary if needed, so its label can be set again.

steps.step: track progress toward a target or a total
steps.here: 'Find first unlabeled' jumps to the page and plot of the first series that still has no label.
Each time a full page is labelled, the label array is saved to a per-user backup.pkl in the results folder.

distinctive: Each series is shown folded at its reported period and at twice that period, side by side on one axis, so period-halving errors (common with eclipsing binaries) can be spotted.
The y axis is inverted (magnitude convention) and scaled to the median ± 3 interquartile ranges, so outliers don't flatten the curve.
Labels are kept per username and resumed from a backup, so several people can label the same set separately.
Labelling moves through a page grid of nine plots rather than one item at a time.

parts.title: Username log-in
parts.summary: Asks for a username, creates that user's results folder, reloads any saved labels and then opens the inspector.

parts.title: Grid of phase-folded light curves
parts.summary: Draws nine series per page as phase-folded scatter plots with error bars, folded at one and two times the period, with a title giving index, file, period and class.

parts.title: Control sidebar
parts.summary: A column of instructions and buttons beside the grid for browsing pages and labelling the current plot, with a legend for the two fold colours.

parts.title: Page navigation
parts.summary: Previous page and Next page buttons, plus a page counter, to move through the collection nine series at a time.

parts.title: Class label buttons
parts.summary: One button per class labels the highlighted series and moves on, saving a backup after each finished page. 'Go back one' and 'Find first unlabeled' move the highlight.
